nom: Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads, Reusable, 3 Pack

avis.texte: Saves me from having to throw out so many disposable ones! And works better without leaving any cotton in your eye.
I love these for facial cleansing. Great for using to remove makeup with micellar water. Great for daily use with whatever cleanser you use. The wash out perfectly in machine and I air dry.
i love these pads! i have been using them since 2022 and still have them! i use them every day and wash them with dove bar soap in the shower. they are truly a staple for me!

This 3 pack is a great value item. It is soft and with the right makeup remover oil or dace wash it works very well and doesnt irritate the skin. I have been able to throw it in the washer and its come back to its original soft fluffy clean shape. I even use it for my under arms. I appreciate resusable items like these that help our environment. Works better than the rough makeup wipes too.
These pads are too soft, making them difficult to use. They are not nearly as good as the ones from Tweezerman.

avis.titre: I like the Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads
avis.texte: I have used both Makeup Eraser pads and the Micellar pads. The Micellar pads work well, wash well and dry fairly quickly. I bought them during a promotion, so the price was better. These pads would work well for travel, too. I'll buy another package soon since there are only 3 in a box.

Omg!! I love these!! They work sooooo well. They are a very big size( you only need one for tour whole face) and they are better for the environment! I wish maybe the pack came with 4 of them or somthing considering the price. But overall great!! I still use cotton pads for toner but i use these for washing my face with miceller water at the end of the day. ( a great steal if you get them on sale!)

avis.titre: Would buy again but only on 50% sale
avis.texte: Kind of pricey for what they are. They are smaller version of make up eraser clothes. So I will use in my travel bag. They came out great in the wash.

avis.titre: Wish I had known these existed sooner! Love!
avis.texte: These are a game-changer! I always felt guilty about using disposable single-use cotton rounds for removing my makeup--these alleviate that guilt perfectly! These pads are so soft and gentle on your skin (especially when removing mascara from your eyes). They are also very quick and simple to clean: running them under water and rubbing soap into them using your fingers for about a minute until you see no visible signs of makeup anymore, then they dry within a few hours! I highly recommend these and may purchase more just to keep at my boyfriend's place. Definitely try them out if you're looking for a more environmentally-friendly way to remove makeup!

This is the same soft fleece as the Makeup Eraser cloth and smaller reusable wipes. As such we know that works to remove many types of makeup. These cloths are very absorbent because they're so fluffy, so one has to take care not to waste too much micellsr water in one use. I have normal skin that can get dry at times in the winter, slightly oily/dewy in the sunmer. I find the Makeup Eraser, like these Garnier wipes, is partislly effective. I don't feel my face gets 100% clean with just the wipes, and the micellar water + wipes do a better job. Yet, this material can be slightly irritating if used with a heavy hand. I still need to use these as part of a dual-wash if removing makeup or heavy skincare. I bought several packs of these when on sale, but will return all but one. While these are mostly effective at cleaning makeup off the face, I don't using them as much as I'd hoped for two reasons: 1) the slight mechanical irritation my skin feels when using such a soft/densely-packed fleece, even when not rubbing hard; 2) there are two layers only stitched around the circle's circumference, so when gently gliding/moving across the face, one layer bunches and it's difficult to keep from adjusting the grip. If these layers were diamond quilt-stitched across the entire area of the wipe, this movement/bunching of the plys would not happen and these would be much easier to glide across the face.

i've been using makeup wipes for soooo long and i finally decided to start using the micellar water and eco friendly makeup cleanser pads, they're amazing!!! they make my face feel so nice unlike when using makeup wipes and its so rough on your face, they're also super easy to clean and they don't break they're good quality!!

I love these makeup remover pads! I use them with the Garnier Micellar Water and they work perfectly! The softness of the pads makes them gentle on the face, while still removing the harshest of makeup. The only thing I wish is that they came in a darker color other than the white/pink because they do get stained after using them. They still come out clean and work well though!

I'm tired of my eyes being bothered by makeup removers. I use warm/hot water on the pad and hold to my eye for about 20 seconds, and see how it's going. It doesn't take much. It works so well. I love it. I do use my old makeup remover to clean the pad after I use it.

What a great idea! I love that you can hand wash these in the sink after using. That makes them perfect for travel. I just keep them in my travel case and after a few trips give them a good wash in the washing machine. The only drawback is I wish they were slightly larger in size. I did have to use all three to get a full face off one night.
I love these pads so much!!! Tried them once now I have a jar full of them. Will continue to purchase these
These are overpriced for what you get: two pieces of cloth stitched together around the edges. They are thin and flimsy. I much prefer other brands of makeup rounds I have tried.
I admittedly didn't read the details- but these have no micellar additive. The product is marketed as part of the line… but what I bought was simply Garnier pads to USE with micellar water.

Very happy with these. They're so soft and they do a great job at getting make up and dirt off without me having to rub my skin too hard. One pad is enough to remove all my makeup vs with cotton rounds, I would have to use about 3 or 4. I'm also really looking forward to not having to spend anymore money on cotton rounds. These are the cheaper option in the long run. I ordered 2 packs but one of them was missing a pad so they sent me another and now I have 8 pads total which is perfect cause they last me a whole week and I throw them in this mesh pouch when I'm done with them, then wash them all at the end of the week. They're very easy to handwash or you can throw them in the washer too. I usually use antibacterial soap or clothes/cotton soap. The soap I use to clean my makeup brushes (IT cosmetics Brush Bath) also works great. I've also heard a lot of people say they use baby shampoo. You can airdry them or throw them in the dryer but if you choose to airdry, make sure you ring them out good or they will take forever to dry. I use a papertowel to squeeze any excess water out after washing and then they dry really fast. Will definitely buy again and will recommend to all my loved ones.

She states works better than the wipes and you can reuse them after cleaning

Tried this when NikkaLaRose recommended it on her YT channel these are sooo good!! These feel so soft on the face, it feels like a fleece type of material and it doesnt pull on the skin like regular reusable cotton rounds. The pads themselves a great size for the face. I wish they came with a little mesh puch to keep them in for travel and washing them. Will defintely repurchase !! 1000/10
So soft, and saves money on reusable pads . Easy to clean also . So glad I finally grabbed them
I actually really like these! I was skeptical but wanted to try these to take off my makeup with something instead of using tissues. They wash really well and are very soft! Would buy again!
Super soft on your skin, washes/dries easily, removes all makeup, and less waste for the planet! You can use 1 pad for a week or two if you wash it nightly. Much better than cotton swabs!
I love this product you don't have to buy cotton rounds all u do is rinse out your Eco pad form removing makeup and dry very easy
This is a great product that is also great for the environment. No more loads of cotton pads to toss in the trash!

Love how soft these are! I've had mines for about a year and they feel just like when I bought them!! Very durable and super easy to take makeup off, I just wash them when I wash my face, or toss them to the washing machine when the makeup is a bit hard to take off. They are very gentle and soft for the eyes and they do a great job!

avis.titre: I would buy this again i loved it
avis.texte: was a great product and it works to get my mascara off everytime

avis.titre: I like them but too soft
avis.texte: It might just be me but these pads are so soft I don't feel like it's cleaning much. It shows on the of that it's taking my makeup off but my face doesn't agree. That's probably my own horrible skin habits of wanting to scrub to clean. I'd definitely recommend but would like a little more reassurance.

So I'm in my 30's and figured I should start taking better care of my face. I've been buying my teenager good skin products so I decided we would share these and some micellar water. I upgraded to these pads instead of wash clothes and oh my! So soft on my skin and if feels so good! You can throw them in the wash and use up to 1,000 times! 10/10 recommmend.

I bought my first set over two years ago and have invested in two additional sets. These work great for applying toner as well as make up remover. I throw them in the washing machine once a week and they still look and feel great.

I love Garnier Eco Pads! They're just as advertised. I purchased the 3pk in Nov 2021. I wash them as recommended the pads don't fray on the ends plus continues to hold its original shape after washing.
My son gifted these to me for Christmas. They're great! They are soft and velvety and very durable! I machine wash them and they are still in great shape!

I usually pump some oil cleanser on one side to remove a majority of my makeup and then put some cleansing water on the other side to make sure i didn't miss any makeup. They are super soft and yes they are only sewn on the edges, but if you're gentle then it won't be an issue.
Love this reusable pads! They make removing makeup almost as easy as Milan's sleeve!! I would highly recommend using them with Micellular remover. Makes my routine simple and easy!
I feel so much better using these instead of wasting so much garbage. You just toss them in the wash and your good to go, I wish they made a 10 pack lol

avis.titre: I love these they are so easy to use.
avis.texte: What I do with these is I pick up the Cleansing Water and then I saturate the pad with the water and it wipes all the Waterproof Makeup I use I would definitely recommend this to a friend.

I was skeptical to purchase these because I thought that my eyeliner would stain it too much. I've never been high maintenance either so the thought of having to wash them before I could use it again seemed so tedious. However I can honestly say That I am shook at how easy it is to clean them. They're soo soft and they feel good to the skin. I use the garnier Micellar cleansing water (blue cap bottle) and it works so good in removing all my makeup. I got tired of using the makeup remover wipes and thought I'd give this a shot - I'm so glad I did because the bottles last me a lot longer than the wipes. Very happy with my purchase!

These pads are 2 pieces of fabric attached only around the edges which makes them bunch up when you use them. Would be much more effective if they did a cross hatch stitching to hold the form. they basically end up in a ball when you use them. They did wash well, but until they fix the bunching, I'll make my own.

These things are amazing. I use them with the garnier micellar water to wipe off my eye makeup and the pads are amazing. I wash them right away with soap and water and at first I was worried because it seemed like the makeup was hard to wash off. You just have to realize the pad is not going to be completely clean with just soap& water, there will still be slight dark smudges visible on it. I mindfully use different parts of the pad throughout the week (still wash w soap and water after every time), then I throw it in the laundry once a week and it comes out perfectly clean. And you get 3 of them so you can rotate. I love that these are reusable & hopefully help reduce overall waste & help the environment (even just a little bit). :)

I use these with the micellar water and it works so good! I love that I can reuse these and not have to waste tons of money on disposable wipes. They are kinda weird to wipe across ur face (because of the two fabrics)so I usually fold it in half or over one finger to remove easier.
The most annoying thing is the pads move around while you are cleaning your face. The pad is two layers, so it slides back and forth. It should have been quilted together.
The rounds are only secured in the edges, so they squish and slide around. I can't get a consistent pressure as I apply to my skin.

avis.titre: Better and softer than cotton rounds
avis.texte: I have nothing bad to say about these reusable pads. I think they are great and super soft. It absorbs the Miceller water really well and takes all my makeup off. I find that using dawn dish soap cleans the pad very well and gets everything off. I would recommend!!!

I do NOT understand how these were designed and made. When I add the micellar water to the pads, it rolls off! The only way I can get it to go into the pad is to cup a pad in one hand, add a little micellar water, and then press it into the pad with my fingers. Ridiculous! Also, making them as two pieces joined only around the edges means that when you start to wipe your face, the two layers shift and roll rather than providing a stable surface for cleaning your face. Lousy product, very expensive for what they are, and they DON'T WORK! I took the loss, threw them away, and went back to cotton rounds.

while I love the idea of a pad that's washable, these have a bit of a flaw. because they are two pieces of fabric sewn together, the two sides move independent of one another. some stitching across the pad to keep it in place would be ideal, but I think I'll stick to the idea I saw on the internet which was basically cutting a thick washcloth in smaller pieces and putting an edge seam on them. upside - they are soft and washed well, but not a fan
I feel I am helping the environment by not adding to the landfill. Easy to wash and clean!!!
I bought these because of the reviews , my organic cotton pads work 100% better with micellar water then this . I really wanted to like it to reuse after washing but I don't

avis.titre: These make removing makeup so easy!
avis.texte: They are very soft, and since they work so well I can keep my towels from getting stained!
I'm glad I discovered these washable, reusable pads to replace single-use cotton pads that come apart. They work well and rinse out beautifully.
My first time buying this, but it's great so far it removes all my stubborn eye makeup.

I use this with Garnier Micellar Water to remove my makeup, and I love it. The reusable pad is very soft against my skin and doesn't irritate it. I'm able to get all of my makeup off very easily. I'd recommend these to anyone.

I like that these are reusable and that you can just throw them in your washing machine. They get my makeup off nicely. After time they can get stained if left alone for long, but I wear lots of black makeup so it did get stained.

avis.titre: Would buy again! Less consumption, hope to save planet
avis.texte: Product is great. Long time wanted to try reusable make up removal pads. Those are big, soft, many (3). Satisfied about my purchase. Thought mascara stains remains. But again, less cinsumption, less garbage, if it helps to save the planet, I will buy it again :)

avis.titre: I love makeup remover cloths but just not this one
avis.texte: I was very skeptical of makeup remover cloths that only need water. I found this on sale and picked it up along with some micellar water. The cloths definitely remove makeup wonderfully and absolutely do not need the micellar water. Garnier is just trying to make a little extra cash by getting you to purchase two products (the cloth and the water) instead of just the cloth. I won't be purchasing these Garnier cloths again though. The two sides of the cloth are separate pieces of fabric that are only sewn together around the outside edge so they slide around on top of each other while I use it making the cloth incredibly difficult to maneuver. I end up folding it into a tiny ball which is still unwieldy but better than trying to use it flat. I will 100% buy another brand and use a makeup cloth daily. I do not recommend this brand.

I use these to take off makeup usually with micellar water or after using makeup melting balms or oils. They are way better than makeup wipes because they don't strip the skin, and they are more environmentally responsible!
These are so gentle. Works so well with the Micellar Water to get my makeup off. Will be buying more!

These are so so SO soft on the skin, they melt away makeup with the micellear water, it's so simple to just clean with soap and water after you use them right before you wash your face, surprisingly durable, makeup washes off of it really easy so it doesn't stain (even mascara!)

These surpassed my expectations. I use them as a replacement for makeup wipes, and to help take off my eye makeup, and as a substitute for cotton rounds. They are softer than any other cotton substitute I've used. They're absorbent enough, but not so absorbent that you end up wasting cleanser. They're also easy to clean. despite the fact I've had them for several months and they've taken off my mascara almost every day, they still look beautiful and have held up well through multiple trips through the washing machine. These are just perfect! They are a staple in my skin care routine now.

I'm using these as a replacement of standard makeup wipes. I like that I can reuse these. I quickly wash one every time I use it (which is daily). it's usually dry by the next day, so I don't have to worry about a soggy pad! the makeup I use does stain it, but it's not a big deal to me.

These reusable rounds are my new favorite item. I have bought reusable rounds before, but they lost their softness quickly and tend to feel rough on my skin. These Garnier rounds are so gentle and they really get the job done! I'm going to buy more!

I love these pads! I now, no longer need to continue to purchase the cotton pads as I have in the past to use with my micellar water. These pads are easy to clean and soft to the touch. They are not harsh or scratch the face. Truly a great purchase (that I never thought I needed).

avis.titre: Gets job done but bad quality
avis.texte: This gets the job done, but these pads are not seen together in the middle making them feel cheap and hard to use. There are definitely better reusable pads, but these are good enough.

After reading 5-star review after 5-star review, I was really excited about these. I feel like I go through the disposable cotton rounds really quickly, so I was excited to find something more sustainable. Personally I have found these difficult to use. One side is pink, the other white, and the two layers are sewn together around the edges, only around the edges. The two layers slide around in the middle since they're only sewn together around the edges and I found it difficult to cleanse well. I'd saturate the pad with micellar water and go to wipe my face and have difficulty getting the pad to move like I wanted because the two layers just slid around on top of each other. I would end up having to fold the pad and try to rub that way and it wasted the water. I'll continue trying to use them for the next few days and see how I feel about them, but I'm just not thrilled so far. I also feel like they take way more micellar water to saturate then because they're so absorbent and it makes it seem as though I'm wasting water or going through it too quickly. Overall it simply didn't live up to the 5 star hype that it seemed to have gained.
This is a great product. Washing it after every use gets annoying, but the makeup always washes out. Very impressed by the quality for that low of a price.
These are awesome! After a month of usage, they definitely have their stains, but it's not like anyone else sees these, so they're totally worth it to me!
I highly recommend these. Comes with 3 cloth pads that are white on one side and pink on the other. They are perfect for micellar water or whatever else.

Say goodbye to wasting so much cotton pads and money on them!! I love these eco pads & you don't need that much micellar water as you would with using a bunch of cotton pads. Also another plus is that it's super soft so you don't have to tug so much on your face. Of course these do stain a little but that's not really a problem for me.

I like how compact this is and that it's reusable. I noticed that I didn't have to use as much micelles water as I would have using a cotton pad. I don't like that even after cleaning with soap they stain pretty bad, although I wouldn't think it to be that much of an issue.

I've been using cotton rounds for several years, and I got tired of purchasing to replenish so often since I use at least 3 pads a day (2 for eyes, 1 for face). I use Garnier Micellar Water to remove my eye and face makeup, and I'm so happy I purchased these! They're so soft and gentle on my skin, and they effectively remove makeup without harsh rubbing or having cotton fuzzies left all over my face and lashes like the disposable cotton rounds did. These also work perfectly to remove stubborn waterproof mascara. I would like to see these come in smaller sizes too, but it's nice you can use one large round for your whole face. Only con is having to wash after every use... or at least I do.
Recently purchased them and they have are such a good size. Very soft and look forward to using them at then end of the day.
This is a great product, very soft and gentle, makes me rly want to use to just to feel how soft it is, plus easy to clean for the most part!

avis.titre: so much softer than disposable cotton pads
avis.texte: these are so soft and amazing, so much better on my face than disposable cotton pads! They are pretty easy to clean when not removing heavy makeup, but if you do use it for that you can pop them in the washing machine.

I really like these eco pads. I use them to remove my eye makeup/mascara along with micellar water. These are like little clouds , very soft and gentle but effective . 3 come in a pack and claims to get 1000 use out of each pad. Which is great because it also helps me use less waste. Also I had when a piece of cotton gets in my eye. They do lose there shape ( more loose) the more you use them but still effective .

I have yet to use this for makeup removal since I hardly wear make up but I do use this after a face wash in the shower to apply my milk toner on my skin. I absolutely love these eco friendly wipes and how much of the towel fuzzies it picks up that I didn't realize were on my skin! My face feels even more bacteria free and clean, and it's super easy to clean and dries fast! HIGHLY recommend to everyone. No breakouts.

These are amazing. I used to be addicted to makeup wipes but didn't like that I was contributing so much to the landfill. Now, I'm addicted to these + micellar water. SO soft, gentle, and really gets the makeup off. Had a little trouble with my mascara but so does any alternative. This is my second purchase of these so I can have them as backup. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: I will buy this as a gift every time
avis.texte: I was looking for a great makeup remover that was easy on the skin. I also wanted something that would allow me to stop using makeup removers and cotton swabs. These pads along with their micellar water is the best makeup remover I've ever used. I would buy these as gifts for friends so they can also be a little more eco friendly.
I love these little things! Gentle on your face and wash really well.

I use these pads to remove my makeup. They work just as well as the disposable kind, but are reusable which is better for the environment. They are also bigger than most of the disposable pads. All of my makeup usually washes off with soap, but mascara can be tough sometimes. After a few uses I throw them in the washer (making sure not to use fabric softener) and they come out good as new.

I will never buy another makeup wipe ever again. These are extremely soft, very large (bigger than the palm of my hand), hold twice their weight in water, are extremely good at cleaning off makeup , easy to clean, AND ARE GOOD FOR THE ENVIRONMENT!! Absolutely phenomenal product I hope they never change anything about it. The only minor issue is that since they are so good at holding water, it's a bit hard to completely air dry them. I've found using a hair dryer works well and fast though so this is not a big deal. Again, best cleaning pads ever :D

This pads is to be used with Garnier micellar cleansing water. It does the job of removing make up and impurities on your skin. It's safe enough to use around the lips and eyes. You get 3 pads in a box and each pad can lasts up to several washes. You can even toss it in the washer with your laundry once a week. I have used it a couple of times because I don't wear make up on a daily basis but noticed that it don't take long to wash it. I was able to get all of the products off even with handwashing. My 11 year old daughter has started using it.

avis.titre: GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS
avis.texte: I received these GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS as a sample from PINCHMe. They are so soft, and best of all, the are washable and reusable! Love!

These Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Pads are so awesome, I love they are washable and reusable. Saves on waste and they clean makeup away like magic, I go through so many little cotton wipes taking makeup off so a reusable pad is so much better for me.

avis.titre: .awesome my face feel super clean and fresh
avis.texte: I received a sample of the full size Garnier skinactive Micellar water and cleansing pad . I love this product. I honestly probably would have never bought it outright because I was u sure if it actually worked. Im so glad I tried it because I love it and I actually had to purchase more because my daughter stole mine.

avis.titre: Soft cleansing pads for all skin types
avis.texte: I received GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS as a free sample from PinchMe. These eco pads are so soft and it is amazing that they can be reused and cleaned for multiple uses which makes them incredibly economical friendly. They are soft and gentle, yet still clean off the heaviest makeup products.

I had a very positive experience with Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads. The product removed my makeup successfully when paired with Garnier Micellar Water. The cleansing cloths are extremely soft and feel great on my face. I like that they are reusable and can be washed in the washing machine. My face felt clean and refreshed after use

avis.titre: GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS
avis.texte: The Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads by Garnier Skinactive are so great at removing makeup and best of all, so gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS
avis.texte: I used the GARNIER SKINACTIVE MICELLAR CLEANSING ECO PADS with the sample of the CLEANSING Water and they really go hand in hand for cleaning my face and removing stubborn makeup. These pads are so soft but they really do clean! They become completely saturated with my old makeup but afterwards are easy to clean. I like that they can be reused. I put mine in the washer with my laundry and they came out fine, ready to use again.

I love that these cleansing pads are reusable. I can buy a few boxes and have enough to use in rotation, toss in a garment bag and wash in the washing machine. This creates less waste and you save money at the same time! The product is soft enough to be gentle around the eyes to remove make-up.
These Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads are SO soft! They are so gentle on the skin and effective in working together with the micellar water to remove my makeup! Love these so much

avis.titre: Reusable pads for the environmentally conscious
avis.texte: I liked the size of these pads and the fact that they were reusable. Nice to see Garnier Skinactive making a green product. My only complaint is they are a bit hard to clean without throwing them in the wash.

avis.titre: Where Have These Been All My Life?!
avis.texte: I received the Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads from PINCHme for free in exchange for an honest review. I'm obsessed! I used to use a washcloth to clean my face, let me just say, ouch! Lol I never thought about the fact that there are products specifically made for this reason. They are so soft and work so well! I also love that they are reusable and help cut down on waste. They are easy to clean, but I was a little dumb and put them in the dryer (it probably tells you not to on the box, but I didn't look haha) so one of them actually burned/melted a little. So any way these makeup remover pads are wonderful in everyway and I think everyone needs some!

avis.titre: Great way to clean your face.
avis.texte: I have been happily surprised after using the micellar cleansing eco pads from garnier skin active. They are so soft and are great at removing makeup. My 3 year old daughter loves to play with my makeup and I use these to clean her face after she is done.

Loved being able to use the Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads. Being able to use a product that helps your skin feel so clean, while leaving no waste for the environment is two wins in my books. Love the feel and how deep they help to clean.

Adding Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads to my beauty cleaning up routine is a must. It helps to get all the grime off and I am confident have a fresh clean face when I am hitting the sack.

I received these Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads from PINCHme in exchange for an honest review! I loved how soft they are and that they are washable. Definitely a plus that it is eco friendly!
I loved the Garnier skinactive Micellar cleansing Eco Pads they were soo soft! I loved how it took my makeup off easily without hurting my skin!
The Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads are soft and convenient to use.

I'm so glad I tried Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads. I love that this is a much more environmentally option! They are gentle on the skin and do a great job at removing makeup and the day's grime. They pair perfectly with the micellar water.
These Garnier Skinactive pads worked well for removing makeup. I really enjoyed using the Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads.

These Garnier Skinactive Micellar Cleansing Eco Pads worked great for removing makeup, dirt, and oil from my skin when combined with Micellar water. They were comfortable to use and eco-friendly. I love the idea of reusable and environmentally-friendly makeup removers. I've gone through many makeup wipes and cotton balls and so on in the past, generating a lot of waste and constantly needing to repurchase. I much prefer this and would recommend. These cleansing pads are soft and lush, and are perfect for cleaning my face with Garniers Micellar Water. I love that they are washable and reusable
